description_en: Stops the ongoing agent generation in a specified conversation and clears pending confirmation operations
description_zh: 停止指定会话中正在进行的Agent生成，并清理待处理的确认操作
name: CancelAgentChat

parameters.help_en: The agent type. Valid values: MaxAgent (default, MaxCompute intelligent assistant) and DataAgent (data analytics agent)
parameters.help_zh: Agent类型。取值：MaxAgent（默认值，MaxCompute智能助手）或DataAgent（数据分析Agent）
parameters.name: agent_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the conversation to stop
parameters.name: conversation_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the turn to cancel, up to 128 characters in length. If specified, only the run corresponding to this turn is canceled to avoid accidentally canceling newly initiated turns in the same conversation. If not specified, the current active run is canceled
parameters.help_zh: 期望取消的轮次ID，最长128个字符。传入时仅取消该轮次对应的运行，避免误取消同一会话中新发起的轮次；不传时取消当前活跃运行
parameters.name: expected_turn_id

openclawCancelled.description_en: Indicates whether the cancellation request is successfully propagated to the agent runtime
openclawCancelled.description_zh: 是否已向Agent运行时成功传播取消请求

reason.description_en: The reason why the run was not canceled or the cancellation failed. An empty string is returned if the cancellation is successful. TURN_ENDED is returned if expectedTurnId is specified and the turn has already ended
reason.description_zh: 未取消或失败原因。成功取消时为空字符串；指定expectedTurnId且该轮次已结束时返回TURN_ENDED

runId.description_en: The ID of the canceled agent run. An empty string is returned if no active run is canceled
runId.description_zh: 被取消的Agent运行ID。未取消到活跃运行时为空字符串

success.description_en: Indicates whether the generation is successfully stopped

errorCode.description_en: The error code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a specific error code is returned to help identify the cause of the error
errorCode.description_zh: 错误码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回具体错误码，用于定位错误原因

errorMsg.description_en: The error message. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, a readable error description is returned
errorMsg.description_zh: 错误信息。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回可读的错误描述

httpCode.description_en: The business status code. This field is not returned if the call is successful. If the call fails, the corresponding HTTP error code is returned, such as 400, 403, 404, or 500
httpCode.description_zh: 业务状态码。调用成功时不返回该字段；调用失败时返回对应的HTTP错误码，例如400、403、404、500

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which uniquely identifies the request and can be used for troubleshooting and log correlation
requestId.description_zh: 请求ID，唯一标识本次请求，可用于问题排查与日志关联
